characters.name: ORAV KUSTI
characters.description: Väike oranž orav koheva sabaga, kandmas heledat rohelist kampsunit. Temal on suured pruunid silmad ja rõõmus näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: HIIR MIINA
characters.description: Väike hall hiir suurte ümarate kõrvadega, kandmas kollast salli ja punaseid pükse. Sõbralik ja uudishimulik ilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: Sunny autumn garden with large maple trees showing bright yellow, orange, and red leaves. Green lawn sprinkled with fallen leaves. A simple dark wooden bench is visible near the back trees. Clear soft blue autumn sky, warm bright lighting, cozy atmosphere. Cartoon children's book style.

pages.text: ORAV KUSTI JA HIIR MIINA ON AIAS.
pages.scene: Orav Kusti (orange squirrel in green sweater) and Hiir Miina (grey mouse in yellow scarf and red pants) stand together in the middle of a sunny autumn garden. They are smiling and looking around at the colorful trees.
Orav Kusti and Hiir Miina stand in the garden looking up in delight as bright yellow and orange leaves gently float down from the trees.
Orav Kusti walks happily across the garden grass carrying a small green toy rake. Hiir Miina stands nearby watching him with interest.
Hiir Miina kneels on the grass, gathering bright red autumn leaves with her hands into a pile. Orav Kusti stands beside her raking more leaves towards her with his green toy rake.
Orav Kusti and Hiir Miina stand proudly next to a large, tall pile of gathered red, yellow, and orange autumn leaves on the green grass.
Orav Kusti leaps excitedly through the air, diving right into the middle of the big colorful leaf pile. Hiir Miina watches him happily with arms outstretched.
Hiir Miina jumps enthusiastically into the leaf pile alongside Orav Kusti. Leaves scatter and fly up into the air around both happy friends.
Orav Kusti and Hiir Miina sit side by side inside the scattered leaf pile, resting happily with leaves on their heads, laughing together under the bright autumn sky.
